in_marathi.name: Neetesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neetesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Neeta’ (Lord) and ‘Ishana’ (Lord of the mind), Neetesh is a name that reflects the spiritual wisdom and divine guidance. It is believed to be the name of Lord Krishna, who is known to bestow his followers with knowledge and wisdom. This name is a reminder to always seek inner peace and enlightenment, and to trust in the divine guidance to lead us towards our life's purpose.
